title: Flow temperature sensor open circuit
causes: The flow temperature sensor or its wiring is faulty.
A loose connection inside the boiler.
steps: Switch the boiler off at the mains switch, wait 30 seconds and switch it back on.
Press the reset button once and give the boiler a few minutes to restart.
If the code returns, do not try to fix it yourself. Note the code and contact your installer or the manufacturer's service line.

title: Safety thermal cut-out has tripped
causes: Water is not circulating well through the boiler.
Closed radiator valves or air in the system.
Low system pressure or a pump fault.
steps: Make sure the radiator valves are open.
Look at the pressure gauge. With the heating cold it should read about 1 to 1.5 bar.
If the pressure is low, top it up with the filling loop exactly as your user manual shows, then close the loop fully.
Bleed any radiators that are cold at the top, then check the pressure again.
Press the reset button once and give the boiler a few minutes to restart.
If the code comes back after one or two resets, stop resetting and book a repair.
technician: Internal parts must only be checked by a Gas Safe registered engineer (UK) or a licensed heating installer.

If you often need to top up, there may be a leak. Ask an engineer to find it.
